name: Bank VTB (Belarus)
note: Partner of HC Dinamo Minsk (club partners page). Propose severe: the bank is part of the VTB group; the Russian Federation controls VTB (Rosimushchestvo 60.93% of ordinary shares), and Russia's war in Ukraine goes on — mirrors the existing Gazprom rating.

why.text: Bank VTB (Belarus) is part of the VTB group, which the Russian state controls through Rosimushchestvo's 60.93% holding of its ordinary shares. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and has been at war with Ukraine since. A famous jersey makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
